text:
emma: Quick pass on Compliance > Data controls — caught 4 small but important UX/accessibility items: encryption pill affordance, retention unit clarity, region grouping + tab order, and audit CSV phrasing.
raj: drop the current strings/screenshots? I'll take a patch after stand.
emma: badge currently shows 'Encrypted (KMS)' as a tiny non-focusable pill. Tooltip is long and hover-only. On phones it wraps badly.
amber: SR/readout note: parentheses + acronym read awkwardly. Short visible label should be TTS-friendly. Suggest: 'Encrypted — customer key' (no parens). Put 'KMS' inside the long panel only.
raj: accessibility/color: our green chip at #007a50 measures ~2.9:1. Need >=4.5:1 for normal text. Two options: darker fill (#004e38) or light chip with dark text and 1px border.
emma: implementation preference: make the pill a <button> so keyboard users can tab to it. Use aria-describedby to point at a hidden panel with details. aria-label suggestion: 'Encryption: customer-managed key, press enter for details.'
sam: good. For mobile tap -> open sheet with id kms-panel-195678 so it reads well on voiceover.
emma: second item: retention control. Current UX uses a bare numeric input (shows '30') and audit entries read 'Retention set to 30' which confused compliance.
audrey: please show units inline — either suffix 'days' or a segmented control (days/weeks/months). Also logs should be explicit: 'Retention set to 30 days'.
raj: suggestion: store machine value as integer 'duration_days' in CSV and add a human column 'change_summary' for exports. Example CSV row: actor,action,target,timestamp,duration_days,change_summary
jane,update_retention,org-xyz,2026-01-14T11:04:05+00:00,30,"Retention set to 30 days (reason: project cleanup)"
emma: third: region selector groups recent regions at top visually, but DOM places them after the full list. Keyboard users land in the long list first. Fails linear flow.
sam: simple fix: reorder DOM to match visual grouping (recent -> all). Add aria-describedby on the group label for screen readers so they understand grouping.
audrey: also add visible heading inside the select panel: 'Recently used' + distinct role="group" for SRs. Make sure tab stops are logical.
emma: fourth: audit CSV wording + timezone. Compliance asked that exported timestamps include zone offset and that 'days' unit is explicit. Also they'd like an optional 'reason' column when admins change retention.
raj: will add columns: duration_days, change_summary, utc_offset. Update exporter to use ISO-8601 with offset (e.g., 2026-01-14T11:04:05+00:00). Keep backwards compatibility by versioning CSV schema to v3.
audrey: i'll add e2e + axe checks: 1) pill is focusable and SR announces aria-label; 2) color token meets contrast; 3) tab order matches visual grouping for region + retention; 4) retention control displays unit; 5) audit CSV contains duration_days and change_summary when reason provided.
sam: plan: small UI patch — make pill a button with id kms-pill-195678, darken to #004e38, wire panel kms-panel-195678 for details; switch retention to number + unit suffix (default days), update DOM order for region grouping, and bump audit exporter schema to v3 with new columns.
ops-bot: Deploy to staging scheduled by @sam at 1956789028 :rocket:
emma: thanks. After deploy I'll run the keyboard walkthrough and request a quick compliance export sanity check. Prefer to land before next patch release. :thumbsup:
